terra.problem: ‘Nobody gets a second helping’ adds a detail about the locusts that the text does not give.
The text says the sweet wine is cut off from the drinkers, not that the whole supply is gone.
Comparing the loss to getting weepy over the last cookie makes light of the suffering in the passage.
‘The wine is simply gone’ goes beyond the text, which says the sweet wine is cut off from the drinkers.
‘Not pulled up’ asserts that the tree was not uprooted. The text does not say either way.
‘He clearly wants it to land’ assigns Joel a motive. The final sentence also asserts a causal link between the lost grain and the offerings that the text does not state.
The text says the priests mourn; it does not say nobody in the house is celebrating or explicitly give the reason for their mourning.
The passage does not say the farmers and vinedressers feel the loss first or describe a whole season of work.
The passage does not mention festivals or say that their loss causes the loss of joy.
‘One night, start to finish’ adds a precise limit to the instruction to spend the night in sackcloth.
‘Everybody else comes’ presents the commanded gathering as an event that has happened.
‘The elders first, and then everybody’ adds an order of arrival the text does not give.
‘Once everyone is in the room’ adds a setting, while ‘No plan, no speeches’ asserts details the text does not give.
‘There’s no joke to make about it’ comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
The text says the herds have no pasture, not that they have nowhere to settle.
‘The prayer isn’t only from people’ presents the animals’ panting as prayer. The text says they pant for the LORD, but does not call it prayer.
